about_the_game:
You’re the engineer aboard a rickety spaceship with a mind-bending problem: the engine’s broken, and the only way to fix it is to shrink - again and again - diving into recursive layers of strange machinery and stranger worlds.

Explore the vast, nested universe hidden inside your ship. Fix broken parts, solve whimsical puzzles, and meet eccentric beings who dwell within the gears and circuits.

  • Recursive shrinking – Dive into increasingly smaller worlds within worlds to uncover secrets and solutions.

  • Exploration-based puzzles – Solve spatial challenges and mechanical mysteries as you repair the different parts of the ship.

  • Whimsical environments – From cosmic gearboxes to grandma beetle's bakery, each area offers a unique vibe and visual style.

  • Narrative surprises – Uncover quirky stories and characters hidden within the ship’s inner worlds.

  • A compact open world – A vast open world fractally compressed into a two-person space shuttle

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo SU9400 or Apple M1
  • Memory: 150 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU with Metal 3 support (e.g. Intel HD Graphics 5500 or Apple M1 integrated GPU)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound
  • Additional Notes: Requires a GPU with Metal 3 support
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8500 or Apple M1
  • Memory: 150 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated or integrated GPU with Metal 3 support (e.g. Apple M1 or newer)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated sound
  • Additional Notes: Apple Silicon (M1 or newer) recommended for optimal performance

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8200 or AMD Athlon BE-2300
  • Memory: 150 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 5500 or AMD Radeon R5 (Kaveri)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound card
  • Additional Notes: Requires a GPU with Vulkan 1.0 or Direct3D 12 (12_0) support
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 150 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 or AMD Radeon RX 460
  • Storage: 500 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated sound card
  • Additional Notes: GPU with Vulkan 1.2 or Direct3D 12 (12_0) support recommended for best performance

short_description: Scale into ever-smaller nested worlds. Shrink into your spaceship's mechanisms. Uncover the fractal worlds within and meet the zany goobers who call them home. Track down the root of the system errors, whether by replacing old gears or getting Grandma Beetle's bakery back in business.
